_comment: Benika Akagane, the iron club oni (SLICE_PLAN 3.3, kit sheet docs/heroes-v2/kits/benika_akagane.txt). The kit fields are the slice fixture's (src/test/resources/heroes/slice/benika_akagane.json); art and animations are source only (HEROES_V2 12.5, 12.6). One body for good (the owner's rule of 2026-11-13, HEROES_V2 3.6): an adult of ordinary size, large build, drawn at 108%.
name: Benika Akagane
title: the Iron Club Oni
description: A laughing oni smith-warrior who wants an opponent worth breaking her club on.

weak_points.hint: Ugh, cold! Who throws snow at an oni?!

transition.line: Don't you dare fall down yet!

intro.line: Oho! You look sturdy. Let's find out!

quirks: has a sweet tooth she defends with her club

founding: Listen up! From today we're the Crimson Anvil. We work hard and we fight harder!
last_stand: Hah... hah... this is GREAT! Don't you dare stop now!
fallen: Good one... Next time I break the club on you.

ben.os_dip._comment: Overhead Slam anticipation: the knees give and the club dips forward off the shoulder.

ben.os_raise._comment: Overhead Slam wind-up: the club raised high over the right side of her head in both hands, pointing up and a little back, the chest lifting.

ben.os_peak._comment: Overhead Slam's last stretch: the club tipped back over her head, the chest arched like a bow.

ben.os_fall._comment: Overhead Slam mid-swing: the club coming down level over her head, the hips folding into it.

ben.os_slam._comment: Overhead Slam's contact: the club driven straight down club-first into the ground in front, both hands on it, folded deep over it with the knees bent.

ben.os_tug._comment: Overhead Slam recovery, the club stuck: she leans back and hauls on it while it stays in the ground (her hands where they were at the contact).

ben.os_pry._comment: Overhead Slam recovery: the club pried up out of the ground, its head rising in front.

ben.sc_set._comment: Shoulder Charge wind-up: she drops her left shoulder at the target, the torso turned right and folded forward, the left forearm braced up before her face, the club trailing low behind her in the right hand; the knees deep.

ben.sc_snort._comment: Shoulder Charge's tell: a bull's lowered head, the shoulder rolled forward a little more.

ben.sc_run_a._comment: Shoulder Charge, the run in place (the server carries her): the right knee driving up, the left leg pushing back, both feet just off the ground.

ben.sc_run_b._comment: Shoulder Charge, the other stride: the left knee up, the right leg back.

ben.sc_skid._comment: Shoulder Charge's end: braked on deep knees, the hips sunk back and the left shoulder still leading, the club dragging behind.

ben.sc_hop._comment: Shoulder Charge recovery: a small hop back to her footing, the club swung up toward the shoulder.

ben.sc_roll._comment: Shoulder Charge recovery: rolling the left shoulder with a grin, the club back on the right shoulder in the right hand.

ben.gs_shift._comment: Ground Stomp: the weight shifted onto the left leg, the hips tipping, the club swung up in the right hand and the left arm out for balance.

ben.gs_lift._comment: Ground Stomp's tell: the right knee hauled high and out to the side (a sumo's stomp), leaning on the left leg, the club held high at the right and the left arm flung out.

ben.gs_stomp._comment: Ground Stomp's contact: the right foot slammed down on its spot, sunk into a deep wide squat, the club's head planted on the ground at her right side as a brace and the left hand on the left knee.

ben.gs_hold._comment: Ground Stomp, the ring rolling out: the squat held, the chest lifted, grinning.

ben.gs_rise._comment: Ground Stomp recovery: up from the squat, the club lifted back toward the shoulder.

ben.gt_wind._comment: Grab and Throw wind-up: crouched forward, turned a little to the left, the left hand drawn back open at her side, the club swung down behind her in the right hand.

ben.gt_grab._comment: Grab and Throw's grab: a lunge, the left hand shot forward at chest height and closed.

ben.gt_lift._comment: Grab and Throw, the hold: the seized enemy hoisted up overhead in the left hand, the chest leaning back, laughing.

ben.gt_cock._comment: Grab and Throw: the held enemy drawn back over her head, the chest twisting right and arching.

ben.gt_throw._comment: Grab and Throw's throw: the left arm whipped forward and down, the hips and chest unwinding to the left, the weight on the front.

ben.gt_follow._comment: Grab and Throw follow-through: the left arm carried on across and down, the body folded.

ben.gt_laugh._comment: Grab and Throw recovery: upright, the left fist on her hip, laughing with the club swung back onto the right shoulder.

ben.mc_crouch._comment: Meteor Club wind-up: down into a deep gathering crouch, the club raised high over her head in both hands, the eyes on where she will land.

ben.mc_launch._comment: Meteor Club's launch: the legs driving straight with the toes pointed, the club high over her head, the body stretched up.

ben.mc_air._comment: Meteor Club in the air: the knees tucked up, the club cocked back over her head, the body arched.

ben.mc_drop._comment: Meteor Club coming down: the club whipped forward over her head, the legs reaching for the ground.

ben.mc_crash._comment: Meteor Club's crash: landed in a deep squat on her stance spots, the club driven club-first into the ground in front, folded over it.

ben.mc_tug._comment: Meteor Club recovery: the club stuck in the crater, hauled on while it stays put.

ben.cw_raise._comment: Crash Waves: the club hoisted high over the right side of her head in both hands between blows, the knees still bent from the landing.

ben.cw_slam._comment: Crash Waves' blow: the club smashed down club-first into the ground in front (each blow sends a ring of fire).

ben.ul_raise._comment: Iron Mountain Crash wind-up: feet set wide, the club raised as high as she can reach over the right side of her head in both hands, chest out ('Hold still, this'll be fun!').

ben.ul_peak._comment: Iron Mountain Crash wind-up: the club tipped back behind her head, the whole body drawn like a bow, trembling with the gathered power.

ben.ul_crouch._comment: Iron Mountain Crash: the last gather before the leap, sunk deep with the club still behind her head.

ben.ul_apex._comment: Iron Mountain Crash at the top of the leap: the body arched back with the legs trailing below it, the club drawn far back over her head.

ben.rg_load._comment: Rage begins: hunched, the head down and the shoulders up, the club gripped in the right hand at her side and the left fist clenched before her, shaking.

ben.rg_roar._comment: Rage: the arms flung wide, the club out at the right and the left fist at the left, the chest thrown out and the head back in a roar.

ben.p2_clutch._comment: Phase 2: the horn flares; the left hand clapped to her brow under it, the head bowed, the club held low.

ben.p2_laugh._comment: Phase 2: the head thrown back laughing ('Now THIS is a fight!'), the left hand dropped to her side, the club swung up.

ben.p3_wipe._comment: Phase 3: the back of the left wrist dragged across her mouth, the head low, the club held in the right hand.

ben.p3_grin._comment: Phase 3: the head down and the glowing eyes up at the enemy, a wide fang grin, both hands on the club before her.

ben.in_plant._comment: Intro: the club swung down and planted head-first in the ground at her right front with a thump, sunk low over it.

ben.in_crack._comment: Intro: up again with the club back on her right shoulder in one hand, the left fist brought up before her chest and squeezed (the knuckles crack), the head tilted.

ben.vi_laugh._comment: Victory: the club up on the right shoulder in the right hand alone, the left fist on her hip, the head thrown back in a laugh.

ben.vi_point._comment: Victory: 'Next!': the left hand flung forward pointing at the next one, leaning in, the club on her shoulder.

ben.ta_slap._comment: Taunt: the club's head slapped down into her open left palm before the chest.

ben.ta_lift._comment: Taunt: the club lifted off the palm between slaps.

ben.ls_pant._comment: Last stand: bent over, panting, the left hand on the left knee and the club propped on the ground at her right side.

ben.ls_up._comment: Last stand: straight up with a wild grin, the club hoisted high in the right hand, the left fist pumped.

ben.cw_lift._comment: Pulled out of the crater: the club drawn straight up out of the ground in both hands, its head still pointing down, the body rising off the crash.

ben.cw_free._comment: A third of the way out of the crater: the club drawn up out of the ground, its head still down, the body rising off the crash.

ben.cw_free2._comment: Two thirds of the way out of the crater.

move.overhead_slam.description: Overhead Slam (move slot 0, a cone of 4 at 40 degrees, area: 1.0 / 0.15 / 1.2 s): the knees give and the club dips off the shoulder (0.15 s), then rises for a whole slow second over the right side of her head in both hands, the chest lifting, tipped back at its peak with a tremble (0.55-0.8 s: the tell), whipped down through the level (0.86 s) and driven club-first into the ground in front at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20: the burst of fire), the knees giving under it, 1.00 s (cast, tick 22). Stuck: she hauls on it twice while it stays in the ground (1.1-1.55 s: the punish window), pries it out (1.75 s) and swings it back onto her shoulder by 2.25 s. Feet planted.

move.shoulder_charge.description: Shoulder Charge (move slot 1, a charge of 10 at 160%, heavy: 0.9 / 0.6 / 0.9 s): she turns her left shoulder to the target and drops into a deep crouch, the left forearm braced up before her face and the club trailing low behind (0.25 s), and snorts like a bull, the head bobbing and the shoulder rolling (the tell, to 0.75 s); the burst at 0.80 s (hit, tick 18) and a driving run in place, the server carrying her, to the brake on deep knees at 1.35 s (cast, tick 29); a hop back to her footing (1.6 s), a roll of the shoulder with a grin and the club back on it by 2.3 s.

move.ground_stomp.description: Ground Stomp (move slot 2, a ring of fire of radius 8, area: 1.0 / 1.0 / 0.8 s): the weight shifts onto the left leg and the club swings up in the right hand (0.3 s), then the right knee is hauled high and out to the side like a sumo's, the left arm flung out (0.55-0.82 s: the tell), and the foot slams down on its own spot at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20) as she sinks into a deep squat with the club's head planted beside her; she holds it, grinning, while the ring rolls out (to 1.85 s, cast, tick 39), and rises back to her stance by 2.7 s.

move.gourd_swig.description: Gourd Swig (move slot 3, on herself, light: 1.2 / 0.1 / 0.6 s): the club kept on her right shoulder in the right hand, the left hand reaches across and takes the gourd from her right hip (0.25 s), tips it up to her mouth with the head thrown back and drinks long and deep (0.5-1.0 s, the gulps bobbing her head; the drink's sound is the server's), lowers it with a satisfied 'Ahh!' at 1.10 s (hit, tick 24: the heal and the strength), 1.15 s (cast, tick 25), wipes her mouth with the back of the wrist (1.32 s) and hangs it back at her hip (1.55 s), on guard by 1.8 s. The gourd moves with her hand (its own bone, keyed). Upper body.

move.grab_throw.description: Grab and Throw (move slot 4, a grab of 2.5, heavy: 0.9 / 1.0 / 1.2 s; phases 2-3): crouched forward with the left hand drawn back open and the club swung down behind her in the right hand (0.3-0.72 s: the tell over the purple mark), the lunge and the left hand closing on the enemy at 0.80 s (hit, tick 18), the enemy hoisted overhead and shaken while she laughs (1.0-1.4 s), drawn back over her head (1.62 s) and hurled forward and down at 1.75 s (cast, tick 37: the throw), the arm following through across her body, then upright with the left fist on her hip, laughing, and the club back on her shoulder by 3.0 s.

move.meteor_club.description: Meteor Club (move slot 5, a leap of 10 with a landing of radius 3, heavy: 1.0 / 0.6 / 1.2 s; phase 3): down into a deep gathering crouch with the club raised over her head in both hands, the eyes on where she will land (0.35-0.82 s: the tell), the launch at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20), in the air with the knees tucked and the club cocked back over her head (1.1-1.25 s), whipping it forward as she drops (1.38 s) and crashing down club-first in a deep squat at 1.45 s (cast, tick 31: the burst of fire; the ground stomp follows). Stuck: hauled on twice, pried out (2.2 s) and back onto her shoulder by 2.7 s.

move.crash_waves.description: Crash Waves (move slot 6, the ultimate's followup: three rings of fire 0.6 s apart, area: 1.0 / 1.8 / 0.8 s): from the crater of Iron Mountain Crash she wrenches the club free (0.25 s), hoists it high (0.7 s) and smashes it down at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20: the first ring), hoists and smashes at 1.50 s (hit, tick 32) and 2.10 s (hit, tick 44), each blow sending a ring, holds the last blow while the rings roll out to 2.65 s (cast, tick 55), and rises laughing with the club back on her shoulder by 3.5 s. It starts on the ultimate's crash, so it follows it without a jump.

ultimate.description: Iron Mountain Crash (the ultimate, a leap of 10 then three rings of fire, 1.8 / 2.0 / 1.6 s): feet set wide, the club raised as high as she can reach in both hands with a shout ('Hold still, this'll be fun!', 0.35 s), tipped back behind her head with the whole body drawn like a bow and trembling (0.75-1.35 s), sunk into a deep crouch (1.55 s) and launched at 1.70 s (hit, tick 36); up high, arched back with the club drawn far behind her head (2.3-3.05 s), folding forward as she drops (3.4 s) and crashing club-first into a deep squat at 3.65 s (cast, tick 75: the crash; Crash Waves follows from here). Stuck in the crater, a laugh, pried out (4.6 s) and back onto her shoulder by 5.3 s.

state.rage.description: Rage begins (state slot 0, played as phase 2's transition ends and Rage starts; again whenever she re-enters it): hunched and shaking with the club gripped low and the left fist clenched (0.25 s), then the arms flung wide and the chest thrown out in a roar (0.55-1.05 s: the state's sound is the server's), the knees giving, back on guard by 1.6 s with the angry face Rage keeps.

phase.2.description: Phase 2 (inside the 1.2 s transition; her horn and arm stripes flare): the left hand clapped to her brow under the blazing horn, the head bowed (0.2 s, the flare sound), then thrown back laughing ('Now THIS is a fight!', 0.45-0.85 s), back on guard by 1.1 s; Rage follows.

phase.3.description: Phase 3 (inside the 1.2 s transition; her eyes glow and steam rises from the horn): the back of the left wrist dragged across her mouth, the head low (0.3 s; the steam sound and its puff), then both hands on the club with the head down and the glowing eyes up at the enemy, a wide fang grin ('Don't you dare fall down yet!', 0.55-0.9 s), back on guard by 1.1 s.

intro.description: Intro (the server holds the intro as long as the clip, 1.5 s): 'Oho! You look sturdy. Let's find out!' The club swung down and planted head-first on the ground at her right front, the right hand resting on its handle, sunk low over it (0.3 s), then up again with the club back on her shoulder in one hand and the left fist brought up before her chest and squeezed till the knuckles crack (0.65-1.1 s, her intro sound), the head tilted with a fang grin, on guard by 1.5 s.

victory.description: Victory (code 20), 2.2 s: the club swung up onto her right shoulder in one hand, the left fist on her hip, and a big laugh with the head thrown back (0.35-1.3 s), then the left hand flung forward pointing at the next one ('Next!', 1.55 s) with a fang grin, back on guard by 2.2 s.

taunt.description: Taunt (code 14), 1.5 s: the club's head slapped down into her open left palm twice (0.35 s, 0.75 s) with a smug fang grin and the head tilted, 'come on, then', back on her shoulder by 1.5 s.

last_stand.description: Last stand (no action code yet: for the engine side to play at the last-stand beat, HEROES_V2 6.13), 1.6 s: 'Hah... hah... this is GREAT! Don't you dare stop now!' Bent over panting with the left hand on her knee and the club propped on the ground (0.1-0.6 s), then straight up with a wild grin, the club hoisted high in the right hand and the left fist pumped (0.85-1.3 s), back on guard by 1.6 s. She never escapes: there is no escape clip.

personal.1.description: Shoulder roll (personal.1, a rare idle), 2.6 s over move.idle (the club on her back): the right shoulder rolled round twice (0.2-0.9 s, her quirk sound), then the left (1.0-1.7 s), the neck cracked to one side and the other with a pleased grin (1.8-2.3 s).

personal.2.description: Gourd sip (personal.2, a rare idle), 3.0 s over move.idle (the club on her back): the right hand takes the gourd from her hip (0.35 s), a long sip with the head back and the eyes shut (0.8-1.5 s, her quirk sound), lowered with a contented sigh and a blush (her sweet tooth: the gourd is not sake), hung back at her hip (2.3 s). The gourd moves with her hand.

personal.3.description: Club spin (personal.3, a rare idle), 3.2 s over move.idle: the right hand reaches over her shoulder for the club on her back (0.4 s), swings it out at her right side and twirls it once round in a big circle (0.7-1.4 s, her quirk sound), catches it and rests it on her shoulder with a grin (1.75-2.3 s), then slings it back onto her back (2.7 s). The club's carried copy moves with her hand (the weapon flag stays sheathed: an idle never changes it).
